patch_description: Replace the single 5,6,5,6,4 lattice initialization with a portfolio centered on the stronger five-row 5,6,5,5,5 contact graph and its vertical reversals and boundary-defect variants.  The prior initialization has overly tight five-circle rows for radius 0.1, whereas these seeds are deliberately feasible at small radius and allow SLSQP to choose unequal boundary radii.  Independent row phases and asymmetric left/right margins expose contact graphs that reflection-symmetric starts tend to miss.  The optimizer still retains restarts around its incumbent arrangement, but now first explores materially different layered geometries.
